environment: local tabletop; no payment/map/carrier/notification/cloud provider contacted

runs.environment: local tabletop; no external provider contacted

records.failure_injected: provider call unavailable before a known result
records.expected: No transactional success, circuit opens, and retry policy remains bounded.
records.gap: Live provider sandbox outage and callback/reconciliation replay remain external release evidence.
records.remediation_due: Before enabling a live payment provider or payment-dependent market

records.failure_injected: route provider unavailable
records.expected: Degraded route is explicit and cannot become pricing truth.
records.gap: Provider sandbox/edge outage and customer degraded-route UI need an approved staging window.

records.failure_injected: carrier event delivery unavailable
records.expected: Canonical status becomes UNKNOWN and the event remains replayable.
records.gap: External carrier sandbox outage and signed webhook replay remain unexecuted.

records.failure_injected: queue acknowledgement and Redis admission control unavailable
records.expected: Outbox work remains durable/replayable and writes are bounded rather than falsely accepted.
records.gap: Live staging broker/Redis failover and recovery timing remain to be run in an approved window.

records.failure_injected: replica/read path unavailable while the writer is fenced
records.expected: No stale transactional read/write; promotion is explicit and writes stay fenced until approval.
records.gap: A real staging replica restore and measured RPO/RTO require provisioned replica infrastructure.

records.failure_injected: push delivery unavailable after domain commit
records.expected: Domain transaction remains committed, delivery is deferred, and client success is not fabricated.
records.gap: FCM/provider outage and replay need the approved provider project and device evidence.

records.failure_injected: new-order gate enabled for a bad revision
records.expected: Only new orders are rejected; active-order recovery remains available.
records.gap: The control is proven by a staging kill-switch drill; a multi-market rollback remains a release exercise.

records.failure_injected: release policy marks an unsafe version hard-gated
records.expected: New transactions are gated while active-order and support recovery remain available.
records.gap: Play/internal percentage rollback and process-death active-order proof remain release-owner evidence.

records.failure_injected: SOS provider unavailable for an active incident
records.expected: Incident is persisted and honest local fallback is shown; no provider success is claimed.
records.gap: Market-specific emergency provider/call-center configuration remains an owner decision.

records.failure_injected: provider statement and internal amount do not match
records.expected: Mismatch is isolated and corrected only through an append-only compensating entry.
records.gap: Provider invoice/bank movement reconciliation needs a real provider statement and Finance sign-off.
records.remediation_due: Before settlement close or payment-provider launch
